**Finding submitted — deviation (AUDIT), fallback target.**

- **Responsive clause:** § 3.4 (p0022) is the only inspection right in the agreement; searches for audit/records/review/examine surfaced no other provision, and § 5.4's General Manager clause is definitional only.
- **Direction:** the right runs to HDI (Vendor) against the Company's (Customer's) records, so it is properly flaggable.
- **Already at fallback:** 30 days' prior written notice (exceeds the 15-day floor) and HDI bearing inspection fees unconditionally (more favourable than the 10 percent underpayment trigger — not upgraded or made more onerous).
- **Failure:** no frequency cap at all, i.e. unlimited inspections, which is walk-away territory.
- **Cure:** one insertion of "no more than once per year," preserving every other word, including the business-hours and cost sentences. Preferred-only refinements (independent auditor, confidentiality, off-site, no system access) were not added because the clause is records-only and grants no system access.
